summary_1line: After Vichitravirya dies childless, Satyavati urges Bhishma to produce heirs, but he refuses, reaffirming his unbreakable vow of celibacy and truth.

image_candidates.scene_text: Satyavati, grieving yet resolute, pleads with Bhishma in the royal hall to preserve the Kuru lineage after her son’s death.
Bhishma stands firm before the court, declaring that even if the elements abandon their nature, he will never abandon truth or his vow.
